name: B10-0026/2024 (The Left) – The severe situation of political prisoners in Belarus
title: Resolution on the severe situation of political prisoners in Belarus
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on political prisoners in Belarus and calling for action. It asks for the release of all people held for political reasons, including trade unionists. It condemns the treatment of detainees, urges Belarus to end the death penalty, and asks the European Union and its member states to support United Nations experts gathering evidence of serious crimes.

- No law changes; Parliament only states its opinion and makes requests.
- It concerns political prisoners in Belarus, including trade unionists and journalists.
- Next, the text is sent to European Union institutions and Belarusian authorities.
